name: run-to-completion
description: 🏃 Runs a queue of open work to completion unattended and ships each finished change all the way out: triage into do-now / heavy / gated, execute without stopping between items, ship through an integrated tool that merges, tags, releases and checks the installed copy, and close out with a gated list of what was left and why. Includes an autopilot orchestrator and an attended blocker-clearing pass.
